ambiguity.detail: It is unclear whether Juliana and Alexander are lovers, married, or just companions.
The 'Duke' is referenced without context for a first-time viewer.

verdict.hook_line: The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A scarred veteran hiding a mysterious past shares a tense, intimate moment with a caring woman while rumors of his true identity spread.
verdict.why_it_works: The cold open immediately injects high-stakes mystery before dropping into slow-burn romantic tension.
